facts.fact: Al-Ahram Gate reports that the Personal Data Protection Center (PDPC) was run by an acting chief executive, Soussan El-Okbawy, who chaired a Cairo ICT session on 16 November 2025 and called Law No. 151 of 2020 the foundation for regulating personal data protection.
